versions.summary: Version 2.1.0 Updates: the PRUIndex Income Boost calculator, a new Glass look with smooth animations and animated charts, the Mint theme, settings kept per dashboard, and backup prices when PruAccess is down.

sections.title: New
items: Plan Calculator: PRUIndex Income Boost is now the third plan, next to PRUVantage Assure II and PRUVantage Wealth III. Choose a 5- or 10-year premium term, the premium, the index (UBS, S&P 500 or Barclays) and whether cash benefits are paid out or accumulated. Use the illustration rates from the product pack, or Historical replay to see what the plan would have paid using the index's actual past levels. Generate shows the projected values in the same popup and money format as the other plans.
Income Boost index levels: the levels of the three Income Boost indices are collected every day at 7:10 am Singapore time and build up a longer history over time.

Glass style: frosted, rounded cards on a soft colour background, a floating side menu, page banners that follow your theme and colour palette, and bigger headline numbers. Settings > Style switches between Glass and Classic (the original flat look).
Mint theme: a soft green theme with a dark green side menu. Every other theme and colour palette works with both styles.

Smooth opening: pages, tabs, drop-down menus, sections such as Alert rules and News overview, and pop-up windows now flow in instead of popping up. Tables fade in when you change the period. Switching plans in the Plan Calculator now flows smoothly too.

Logo menu: press the logo at the top left to expand the side menu (icons and page names) or shrink it to a narrow column of icons. The three-line menu button is gone, and each dashboard remembers your choice.

Animated charts: when you add a fund or index, its line draws from the start of the period to the end; a removed one fades away; changing the period redraws every line. The chart in a fund profile draws in the same way.

Backup prices: when PruAccess (the usual source of BID prices) is down, the latest BID price is taken from Prudential's website instead. These funds are marked “Price from Prudential website” in Fund Explorer, and the full PruAccess history replaces the backup prices once PruAccess is back.

sections.title: Improved
items: Settings: style, theme, colour palette and text size are now saved separately for each dashboard, so changing one dashboard no longer changes the others. Your current choices carry over the first time you open it.
More reliable automatic updates: the market news analysis tries again when the AI service is busy, and data updates that finish at the same time no longer block each other.
The user guide is updated for this version.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Settings > Update schedule: Index closes now shows the actual schedule (daily at 6:30 am), and the Income Boost index update is listed.

versions.summary: Version 2.0.0 Updates: market indices across the site, the Annex and Calculator, fund switching in reports, and more reliable data updates.

sections.title: New
items: Market indices: 48 market indices are now tracked alongside Prudential funds, with closing levels updated twice a day, at 6:30 am and 6:30 pm Singapore time.
Market Performance: Switch between Prudential Funds and Indices, compare indices on their own chart, and see the Top 10 and Lower 10 performers for each.
Fund Explorer: Switch between Prudential Funds and Indices. Each index has its own profile with a closing-level chart and returns.
Monitoring: Separate watchlists, alerts and unusual-move lists for indices.
Market News: Shows the indices each story may affect, filters by index, and can show all news, funds only or indices only.

Annex (footer): Prudential product brochures in English and Chinese, grouped the way Prudential sorts them. Plans can sit in several categories and carry any number of tags. Brochures open in a popup with zoom and download, and the plan name opens its product page. The list refreshes every 2 weeks.
Calculator (footer): A PRUShield premium calculator. Age next birthday can be picked from a list, typed in, or worked out from a date of birth.
Feedback (footer): Opens a Google Form for sending feedback or reporting issues.

Calculator: A PruCredit$ calculator. Add plans by typing, pasting, dropping a screenshot or taking a photo (a screen capture on computers, the camera on phones and tablets). It includes a multiplier reference and a breakdown you can download once a plan is added.
Calculator: The Plan Calculator for PRUVantage Assure II and PRUVantage Wealth III is now the first tab on the Calculator page, followed by PRUShield Premium and PruCredit$.
Report Generation, step 6 – Fund switching: switch a percentage of units between funds. A 100% switch also redirects future top-ups. Generated reports list the switches carried out.
Report Generation: BID prices can be changed for purchases, end dates and switches. Published prices are used unless you change them, and any you enter are noted in the report.
Changelog: Click the version number in the footer to see what changed.
User guide: Settings > Help opens a guide to every page, with screenshots, in a popup you can zoom.

sections.title: Improved
items: Monitoring: Choose one or more change periods for the watchlist, from 1 day to 5 years. 1M, 3M and 6M are shown by default for funds and indices.
Returns over periods longer than 1 year are shown annualised (p.a.) in Fund Explorer and Monitoring.
Data updates: If one fund fails to update, the rest still update. The failed fund keeps its last good data and is marked “Not updated since …”.
Lower 10 performers stay hidden until you open them, and hide again on refresh.
Clearer tag contrast in every theme and colour palette.
